adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.handleAdd`, it immediately returns when `multiEmailValue.length === 0` without setting `isInvalidEmail` or showing a toast. This empty-array state is reachable: `MultiEmail`’s remove action (`onClickAddon`) splices the entry out of the `value` array, so deleting the last row results in `[]`, at which point `MultiEmail` renders the “Add Emails” button but the dialog footer “Add” button still calls `handleAdd` and does nothing. This produces a dead-looking primary action with no feedback, matching the finding.
